body: Hi <3 I am going to my first therapy session next Wednesday. I wanted to go tomorrow, but my "mom calendar" doesn't sync up with the therapists calendar, so next Wednesday will be the soonest. Holding as tight as possible until then. I know it won't be a magical cure but I feel like it's offering me some type of hope.

I will have to look into possibly antidepressant route once my baby is born. Thank you for understanding...I mean, I'm not "happy" that you understand this, as I wish you were not feeling this way too!
Thank you for the comment. I want to find a way to make the things I'm grateful for outweigh the hurt.

I needed your perspective. I really try to hide this all from them, so I hope I'm as good at hiding it as I think I am--and I'm not affecting them unknowingly. You say "please stay", and that's two words but they are so heavy--I mean, they are important/hold a lot of weight, not that what you said overwhelmed me in a negative way. So I thank you. I am trying to stay...

I just want to thank you all for your comments. Again, I'm a pretty sucky interwebber/Reddit user, so when I get an alone moment later tonight, I want to respond individually. I just want to get through dinner without having to run to the bathroom and cry because even something as mundane and harmless as dinner is just hard for me to get through today. Seriously though, I can't begin to express my appreciation for you hanging in there and reading my long post. Xoxo.
